points.title: Iteration and the four parts of a loop
points.must: Repeating the loop body; flow line goes back controlled by a decision; initialisation, condition, body, update (no update → infinite loop).

points.title: Three kinds of loop
points.must: Count-controlled (FOR, fixed number), pre-condition (WHILE, tested before, 0+ times), post-condition (REPEAT…UNTIL, tested after, at least once) — each explained with pseudocode.

points.title: Pre- vs post-condition flowcharts
points.must: Both loop shapes drawn: decision before the body vs after the body, arrows back; read-ahead input for WHILE; Yes exit leaves a REPEAT…UNTIL.

points.title: Choosing the right loop
points.must: Known number → FOR; maybe nothing to process → WHILE; must run once first → REPEAT…UNTIL; rogue (sentinel) value to stop.

points.title: Counting and totalling
points.must: count ← 0 and total ← 0 before the loop; count ← count + 1, total ← total + value inside; average after the loop only if count > 0.

points.title: Worked example: canteen
points.must: Sales until 0 entered; count, total and average; check count > 0 to avoid division by zero.

points.title: Largest / smallest value
points.must: max/min set to the first value (not 0 when values can be negative); decision value < min? updates it; e.g. coldest morning in Astana.

points.title: Loop mistakes
points.must: Initialising inside the loop, counter never changed (infinite loop), off-by-one (< vs <=), FOR when the number is unknown.

points.title: Validation and why it matters
points.must: Automatic check that input is reasonable / obeys rules before it is accepted; stops garbage in, garbage out; cannot prove data correct.

points.title: Validation checks as conditions
points.must: Range, presence, length, format, type and lookup checks, each with its decision; checked in order presence → type → format → range, one message each.

points.title: Validation loop flowchart
points.must: Drawn: INPUT → decision → No: clear error message and back to INPUT → Yes: continue; tested with normal, boundary, erroneous data.

points.title: Validation vs verification
points.must: Validation = rules applied by the computer; verification = data matches the original (double entry flowchart, visual check).

points.title: Trace table and test data
points.must: One column per variable; filled row by row by hand to find the output and logic errors; normal, boundary and erroneous test data.

points.title: Flowchart ↔ pseudocode
points.must: Arrows back = loops (diamond first → WHILE, body first → REPEAT…UNTIL, counter → FOR); joining paths = IF…ENDIF; one conversion example (PIN check).
